trial_court: Court of Ms. Payal Singal, Civil Judge - 08 (Central), Room No.283, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi, Suit No : 99738/2016

parties.respondent_defendant: Kartik Chaudhary, s/o Late Sh. Chander Prakash Chaudhry, and others

facts_of_case: The plaintiff filed a suit for recovery of Rs.50,000/- based on a cheque dated 17.05.2014. The defendants are beneficiaries/legal heirs of the deceased Sh. Chander Prakash Choudhary and are liable to discharge the debt.

legal_principles.principle: A suit is not maintainable in its present form if there is no document to prove the alleged cheque was issued by the late proprietor of the firm.
legal_principles.held: It has been submitted that the alleged cheque does not pertain to the defendants and it appears to have been issued on behalf of Firm M/s. La Sigma, and the defendants are not connected with the said firm.

legal_principles.principle: A defendant is not liable for the liability of a deceased proprietor or firm if they are not the beneficiaries of the assets of the deceased or inherited his property.
legal_principles.held: It has been submitted that the defendants are not aware whether the said cheque was issued by Late Sh. Chander Prakash Chaudhary, being the proprietor of M/s. La Sigma to the plaintiff.

outcome.final_order: The suit was converted into an ordinary suit for recovery of money and the defendants were ordered to pay Rs.50,000/- to the plaintiff.

use_for_drafting: drafting a suit for cheque bounce recovery
preparing an application under Order XXXVII Rule 3(5) of CPC
composing a judgment on a civil dispute
